title: GHSL AI agent and CodeQL find privileged workflow code execution in ag-grid
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent and CodeQL
summary: The privileged performance workflow checks out untrusted pull-request code and then runs a repository-local setup action from that checkout, allowing attacker-controlled code execution and possible exposure of repository secrets.
ai_role: The primary GHSL advisory explicitly credits both CodeQL and a GHSL-developed AI agent with discovery; the source does not apportion which tool surfaced the finding first.
classification_note: The sources document the vulnerability and remediation, and make no claim of exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed 2025-08-05 by requiring approval for external fork pull requests.

impacts.conditions: Untrusted input reaches privileged ag-grid workflow; GHSL advisory describes privileged workflow code execution.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
